purpose: Acquire at most four exact root proposals for later genuine original-response labels. Only the original ten training terrains of the frozen public carbon estimator are eligible. No new map, opponent execution, outcome training, or terminal score in selection.
initial_support_audit: The historical 108 signed pairs/18 terrains have local carbon contrast support on 9 pairs/6 terrains; 3 pairs exceed one carbon. This batch prospectively conditions on action-local information before outcomes. Exclude every (physical terrain, physical seat, t) of all 108 signed roots, even if different commands. Do not read their scores. Do not require a free argmax change.
archive: Use precisely the ten training cards in their already-frozen listed order (one historical seat-0 tape each), verified SHA. At each step reconstruct the requested seat's actors and Feat from public observations through that time. Training map labels/hidden carbon/archived future cash do not enter selection. Initial full terrain initializes only the referee and must match its registered hash. The candidate's source tape can include full histories of other policies. Archived actions advance the board only after inspecting that step. No indexing on future outcomes, attributes, subsequent survival, or future action. Compare true incumbent and admissible forced student commands on the exact same current observation.
quota: Map i uses one prespecified (seat, target role), repeating in this exact order: (0,collector),(1,planter),(1,collector),(0,planter). Inspect at t=4,8,12,...,96 chronologically. Inspect all worker slots of target role at an eligible tick, excluding preexisting signed roots. Take the first eligible tick on that map; for ties maximize prospective alternative probability on its finally accepted decoder branch, then lower physical worker UID lexicographically, then physical action order NONE,UP,RIGHT,DOWN,LEFT. Inspect maps in registered order, at most one accepted root per map and stop once four distinct maps are accepted. All failed maps/slots count and report coverage. If fewer than four pass, retain fewer. No retuning of schedule or thresholds.
actions: First arm is exactly normal incumbent integrated decoder's full physical command dictionary. Second arm runs the real learned-carbon package's both autoregressive decoder paths with all earlier commands fixed to incumbent and exactly one focal legal alternative forced; decode every later slot greedily under each path's real changing Prefix. Apply the native return-path protected-slot/added-conflict guard and record which path is selected. Before admitting a root, verify unforced instrumented decode on BOTH packs reproduces the literal public pack entry from the same tracker state. Insist the resulting alternate team differs from incumbent in exactly one physical UID (the focal worker), preserves all bases and adds zero new friendly landing/recruit conflicts. Every forced command and emitted subsequent slot must be legal on its actual branch; check full proposal via replaying its Prefix and retain all per-slot legality, claimed positions and base affordability/recruit slot budget.
network_prior: On the finally selected student's native path, at the actual focal prefix BEFORE forcing the focal command, use the native 0.75/0.25 hybrid logits including the existing return residual iff that branch is selected. Alternative must have rank at most 3 among legal moves (strictly larger logits +1) and softmax probability at least 0.08 at temperature 1. Report parent command probability, alternate probability, legal vector, and logits plus free student decisions. Debias later comparisons by retaining every sign and parent wins when eventual labels are drawn.
carbon: Define D for each physical alternative minus incumbent focal destination. Both maps use deployed byte values in carbon units, canonical reflection for seat 1. Collector test: absolute change (D_student - D_old) >=1 in destination carbon OR mean carbon of the union of all shortest toroidal paths to a nearest own base including endpoints. Planter test: >=1 in the mean of four adjacent ground-carbon cells. Always log all three numeric contrasts, changed destination footprint, and physical destinations. No perturbed team lacking genuinely changed eligible cells can pass.
handoff: Register physical terrain/source hashes, exact persisted prefix of prior archived joint commands or digest+reconstructible slice, public observation hash, current step and seat, original full incumbent action, measured-prior full alternate action, full per-slot decision evidence, and original archive root enemy command after selection only. A subsequent paired label must independently verify equal root observations and exact opponent root command for both arms. Resume common incumbent after the one altered own tick and let the untouched original respond from the next tick. This handoff contains zero ground-truth terminal returns for these new proposals.
